acv.quote: The account was worth about three hundred and twenty K a year.

data.reason: The international half went to Adyen after its country-by-country test, while we offered averages. The US stayed. Elena says nothing could be done, but our late analysis found fixable problems.

trigger.action: Speak to new payments leaders who check declines country by country.
trigger.why: Stefan, the new head of payments, started by pulling declines by country and disliked several international markets.
trigger.quote: the first thing he did was pull declines by country

decider.action: Show approval gains in the customer's own numbers, ready for the CFO.
decider.why: Stefan recommended the switch and the CFO approved it. Stefan said an average would not convince his CFO.
decider.quote: I can't take an average to my CFO.

competitor.action: Write a direct answer to the 'local acquiring' pitch.
competitor.why: Stefan kept repeating Adyen's phrase after its country test, and Elena had no answer. We never saw the test results.
competitor.quote: I don't know what I'd have pitched against that.

message.action: Replace the average uplift claim with a review of their own approvals.
message.why: Stefan met the uplift number with silence but called our analysis of his own numbers the most useful thing.
